grammar.title: Doing as you like with 随便
grammar.explanation: 随便 (suíbiàn) means "as you like, whatever, casually" used to say something isn't strict, or to invite someone to choose freely. As a plain adjective it can also describe careless behavior.

grammar.title: Ranges with 以上 and 以下
grammar.explanation: 以上 (yǐshàng) means "above, or more" and 以下 (yǐxià) means "below, or less" both attach right after a number or noun to mark a range.

sentences.pinyin: Tā suíbiàn shuō le yí jù huà.

sentences.zh: 三十岁以上的人都可以参加。
sentences.pinyin: Sānshí suì yǐshàng de rén dōu kěyǐ cānjiā.
sentences.en: People aged thirty and above can all take part.

sentences.zh: 一百以上的数字很难记。
sentences.pinyin: Yìbǎi yǐshàng de shùzì hěn nán jì.
sentences.en: Numbers above one hundred are hard to remember.
